data.narrative: The student demonstrated outstanding systems architecture and technical leadership in Module 08. They executed a disciplined incremental integration strategy, comparing wire contracts across parallel streams to isolate integration seam mismatches before merging. They authored an end-to-end integration test plan covering happy path, cancellation, and concurrency race conditions, and built a comprehensive Requirements Traceability Matrix tracking 11 requirements with zero unaccounted losses. When an integration seam bug emerged in BREAK ('confirmed' vs 'active' status vocabulary mismatch), they traced the contract divergence and implemented a shared enum single source of truth backed by a 4-pillar contract testing framework.

dimension_scores.observation: Recognized that individual component correctness does not guarantee system correctness, successfully diagnosing the seam divergence between booking status emission and dashboard filter queries.
dimension_scores.evidence: Diagnosed semantic divergence and implemented canonical shared enum in progress/decomposition/module-08-break.md and progress/decomposition/module-08-fix.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Maintained complete end-to-end traceability across all 11 original requirements, identifying built features, conscious simplifications (in-app receipts), and formally scheduled backlog items.
Sequenced incremental merges by contract density, ensuring the foundational booking service validated interface boundaries before payments and UI were introduced.
Designed robust cross-component test scenarios including atomic concurrency mutex locks to prevent provider double-booking under race conditions.
dimension_scores.evidence: Specified concurrent booking test scenario in artifacts/checklists/module-08-integration-test-plan.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Established unambiguous pre-integration checklist standards for datetime serialization (ISO 8601 UTC), UUID formats, and error envelope schemas.

strengths: Exemplary integration discipline: combined incremental merges with pre-merge contract verification to prevent silent system failures.
Rigorous requirements traceability accounting for 100% of requirements with zero unmanaged scope loss.
Architectural foresight: established shared canonical enum contracts and consumer-driven contract testing to prevent semantic drift.

public_evidence.student_action: Orchestrated multi-stream system integration, resolved seam status divergence, and authored full Requirements Traceability Matrix.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Pre-integration contract check, incremental merge log, E2E test scenarios, shared canonical enum, and requirements traceability audit.
public_evidence.proof: Delivered integrated system verification passing all 3 E2E scenarios with 100% requirements accounted for and zero regressions.
public_evidence.ability: Leads distributed system integration, prevents contract drift via shared schemas, and enforces end-to-end requirements traceability.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Shows senior systems architect maturity: unifies parallel workstreams smoothly and guarantees that the built system fulfills the business spec.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Isolated 'confirmed' vs 'active' semantic divergence across component boundaries
Traced 11 requirements from spec to ticket, test, and verification status
Merged streams sequentially by contract dependency density

teaching_approaches.detail: Analyzed Healthcare.gov failure and resolved live contract seam mismatch
